ordered_diagnoses: Primary CNS Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma

s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Referred to a neurologist
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Developed dysarthria, hand tremors, slurred speech, and gait instability
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter
Brain MRI showed absence of contrast enhancement
Brain biopsy revealed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ lymphoma cells
Cerebrospinal fluid presence of lymphoma cells
Bone marrow negative for lymphoma cells
